# has editor

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:hasEditor`](gmeow-hasEditor.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/hasEditor>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/creative-works`](../../slices/creative-works.md)
- **Box roles:** [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

Relates a creative work to an agent that edited, compiled, or curated its content. A flat shortcut subproperty of [`gmeow:hasContributor`](gmeow-hasContributor.md).

**Property shape:** object property; [`gmeow:CreativeWork`](../classes/gmeow-CreativeWork.md) -> [`gmeow:Agent`](../classes/gmeow-Agent.md)
**Sub-property of:** [`gmeow:hasContributor`](gmeow-hasContributor.md)

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use for the flat 80% case of naming an editor, compiler, or curator; often attaches at the [`Expression`](../classes/gmeow-Expression.md) or [`Manifestation`](../classes/gmeow-Manifestation.md) tier of an edited or anthologized edition.

### Avoid when

- Avoid when the editing's period, degree, or evidence must be first-class (promote to a [`gmeow:Contribution`](../classes/gmeow-Contribution.md) with [`gmeow:roleEditor`](../individuals/gmeow-roleEditor.md)), and avoid it for the original author (use [`gmeow:hasAuthor`](gmeow-hasAuthor.md)).

### How to use

- Assert from the edited work to the agent; promote to a [`gmeow:Contribution`](../classes/gmeow-Contribution.md) carrying [`gmeow:roleEditor`](../individuals/gmeow-roleEditor.md) when metadata is needed.
